additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Sander,
Thank you for the quick reply.
For the information: Our charger/ cables has no locking mechanism. It´s always EV who locks the cable. So, if the cable stuck in EV. Its always fault from the car side.
Thank you for your understanding.
